Advancement.name: Advancement
Advancement.description: Progressing to higher levels of responsibility, authority, or scope.
Advancement.example: Example: opportunities to move from specialist to manager over time.

Aesthetic.name: Aesthetic
Aesthetic.description: Working in environments where beauty, design, and form matter.
Aesthetic.example: Example: creating polished visual work and improving how things look and feel.

Affiliation.name: Affiliation
Affiliation.description: Feeling accepted and connected to a supportive work group.
Affiliation.example: Example: being part of a close, collaborative team culture.

Artistic Creativity.name: Artistic Creativity
Artistic Creativity.description: Producing original artistic work with room for imagination and style.
Artistic Creativity.example: Example: creating unique illustrations, writing, music, or multimedia work.

Challenge.name: Challenge
Challenge.description: Taking on difficult goals that stretch skills and problem-solving ability.
Challenge.example: Example: solving complex problems with no obvious solution path.

Change and Variety.name: Change and Variety
Change and Variety.description: Having different tasks, contexts, or priorities instead of repetition.
Change and Variety.example: Example: shifting between projects and learning new tools often.

Community.name: Community
Community.description: Feeling rooted in and connected to a broader local or professional community.
Community.example: Example: work that builds stronger neighborhoods or community programs.

Competition.name: Competition
Competition.description: Measuring performance against peers and aiming to win or outperform.
Competition.example: Example: sales targets, rankings, or performance leaderboards.

Competence.name: Competence
Competence.description: Using skills effectively and being trusted for high-quality execution.
Competence.example: Example: being known as reliable and technically strong in core tasks.

Creative Expression.name: Creative Expression
Creative Expression.description: Expressing personal ideas, voice, and perspective through work output.
Creative Expression.example: Example: shaping content, messaging, or design in your own style.

Creativity.name: Creativity
Creativity.description: Generating novel and useful ideas, methods, or solutions.
Creativity.example: Example: inventing new approaches that improve outcomes.

Decision Making.name: Decision Making
Decision Making.description: Having authority to make meaningful choices that affect outcomes.
Decision Making.example: Example: owning project direction, priorities, or resource tradeoffs.

Excitement.name: Excitement
Excitement.description: Experiencing energy, stimulation, and novelty in day-to-day work.
Excitement.example: Example: high-engagement work with visible momentum and action.

Experience.name: Experience
Experience.description: Building broad real-world exposure to roles, systems, and situations.
Experience.example: Example: rotating across functions to gain practical perspective.

Fast Pace.name: Fast Pace
Fast Pace.description: Working quickly with short cycles, tight timelines, and rapid feedback.
Fast Pace.example: Example: handling frequent deliverables in a high-tempo environment.

Financial Gain.name: Financial Gain
Financial Gain.description: Increasing income through performance, growth, or financial upside.
Financial Gain.example: Example: bonus structures, commissions, equity, or profit sharing.

Friendship.name: Friendship
Friendship.description: Forming warm, personal relationships with coworkers at work.
Friendship.example: Example: enjoying genuine day-to-day friendships on the team.

Help Others.name: Help Others
Help Others.description: Providing direct support that improves another person's well-being or success.
Help Others.example: Example: coaching, mentoring, advising, or solving client problems.

Help Society.name: Help Society
Help Society.description: Contributing to social good and positive impact at a broader level.
Help Society.example: Example: work that advances health, equity, education, or sustainability.

High Earnings.name: High Earnings
High Earnings.description: Prioritizing a top-tier salary compared with alternatives.
High Earnings.example: Example: choosing roles known for strong compensation ceilings.

Influence People.name: Influence People
Influence People.description: Persuading others and shaping decisions, priorities, or behavior.
Influence People.example: Example: guiding stakeholders to align on a proposed direction.

Intellectual Status.name: Intellectual Status
Intellectual Status.description: Being respected for expertise, insight, and intellectual contribution.
Intellectual Status.example: Example: recognition as a thought partner in complex domains.

Job Tranquility.name: Job Tranquility
Job Tranquility.description: Maintaining low stress, emotional calm, and predictable work pressure.
Job Tranquility.example: Example: steady workloads with limited urgency and crisis response.

Knowledge.name: Knowledge
Knowledge.description: Continually learning, understanding, and mastering new information.
Knowledge.example: Example: roles that reward study, analysis, and deep domain learning.

Location.name: Location
Location.description: Working in a preferred geographic setting or physical environment.
Location.example: Example: staying in a specific city, region, or remote setup.

Moral Fulfillment.name: Moral Fulfillment
Moral Fulfillment.description: Doing work that aligns with personal ethics and sense of right action.
Moral Fulfillment.example: Example: choosing projects that match your values and integrity standards.

Organization.name: Organization
Organization.description: Working within structured organizational systems and hierarchies.
Organization.example: Example: operating within established companies, institutions, or formal departments.

Physical Challenge.name: Physical Challenge
Physical Challenge.description: Engaging the body through strength, movement, stamina, or coordination.
Physical Challenge.example: Example: active work with meaningful physical demands.

Precision Work.name: Precision Work
Precision Work.description: Producing accurate, detail-oriented output with minimal errors.
Precision Work.example: Example: tasks where quality depends on careful, exact execution.

Public Contact.name: Public Contact
Public Contact.description: Interacting frequently with clients, customers, or the general public.
Public Contact.example: Example: front-facing roles with regular external communication.

Recognition.name: Recognition
Recognition.description: Receiving visible appreciation, credit, and acknowledgment for work.
Recognition.example: Example: public praise, awards, or clear attribution for contributions.

Research and Development.name: Research and Development
Research and Development.description: Investigating ideas, testing hypotheses, and creating new capabilities.
Research and Development.example: Example: experimentation and prototyping to develop future solutions.

Security.name: Security
Security.description: Having confidence in continued employment and dependable income.
Security.example: Example: stable organizations with low perceived layoff risk.

Stability.name: Stability
Stability.description: Working within consistent routines, structures, and expectations.
Stability.example: Example: predictable schedules and clearly defined processes.

Status.name: Status
Status.description: Holding a respected position with visible prestige or standing.
Status.example: Example: title, role visibility, and perceived importance in an organization.

Supervision.name: Supervision
Supervision.description: Leading, directing, and developing the work of other people.
Supervision.example: Example: managing a team and being accountable for team outcomes.

Time Freedom.name: Time Freedom
Time Freedom.description: Controlling when work is done, including schedule flexibility.
Time Freedom.example: Example: setting your own hours or adjusting work around life demands.

Work Alone.name: Work Alone
Work Alone.description: Having focused, independent work with minimal collaboration demands.
Work Alone.example: Example: long stretches of autonomous work and individual ownership.

Work Under Pressure.name: Work Under Pressure
Work Under Pressure.description: Performing effectively in urgent, high-stakes, or deadline-driven situations.
Work Under Pressure.example: Example: staying effective during peak load and time-critical decisions.

Work with Others.name: Work with Others
Work with Others.description: Collaborating closely and regularly with teammates or partners.
Work with Others.example: Example: planning and executing work through shared responsibility.

default.description: A work-related outcome or condition someone may prioritize in a job.
default.example: Example: choosing roles that better match personal motivation and needs.

selector.instruction: Select the values that matter most to you.
